clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's guest, health educator Cindy Sellers, pointed to a study most soda drinkers have never heard of: eight ounces of anything carbonated - even plain sparkling water - can suppress the immune system for up to twelve hours.

No sugar needed, no extra additives. The bubbles alone are enough to leave your body more open to whatever is going around that day.

Reach for something carbonated every day, and that's twelve hours, every single day.

What's actually in your glass right now?

clips.send: Someone just prescribed antibiotics sends this to a friend already reaching for probiotics, anxiety about wasting the fix.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's guest Cindy Sellers named a mistake she sees constantly: people take probiotics while they're still on antibiotics, trying to protect their gut.

It backfires. The antibiotic can't tell the difference - it takes out the good bacteria you just added right along with the infection it's supposed to be fighting.

Her advice: finish the antibiotic first, nothing else, then rebuild with yogurt, sauerkraut or a probiotic for a couple of weeks after.

Timing the flora, not skipping it, is the part nobody explains.

#kevintrudeau #guthealth #probiotics #wellness #healthfacts #nutritiontips

clips.send: A tired parent sends this to a friend who swears juice counts as water, awe at how simple the fix is.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's guest Cindy Sellers gave a simple test for dehydration: if you can see color in your urine, your body is already asking for water.

Her bigger point was about the brain - it runs on 93% water, and a glass of juice, tea or coffee doesn't count toward that, no matter how much liquid you drink.

She starts every morning with plain water before anything else touches her system.

When's the last time you drank water before your coffee?

#kevintrudeau #hydration #brainhealth #wellness #healthfacts #nutritiontips

clips.send: A raw-food dieter sends this to the friend who swore cooking ruins nutrition, awe at being wrong for years.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's guest Cindy Sellers took on a popular raw-food claim: that cooking gets rid of every enzyme, so your body gets nothing out of a cooked meal.

Her answer - the pancreas produces 325 different enzymes on its own, every time you eat, whether the food was raw or cooked. It doesn't rely on the food to supply them.

That's part of why cultures that cook almost everything have thrived for generations.

Does that change how you think about your next meal?

#kevintrudeau #nutritiontips #digestion #wellness #healthfacts #realfoodfacts

clips.send: A fast eater sends this to someone who always finishes first at the table, anxiety about missing nutrients.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's guest Cindy Sellers pointed out something easy to forget mid-meal: your stomach has no teeth. Neither does your esophagus or your intestines.

Your teeth are the only blender you've got. Swallow food in chunks and your body has to work much harder to pull out the nutrition - some of it never makes it through at all.

Her habit: chew until food turns liquid before swallowing, every bite.

How many chews does your last bite usually get?

#kevintrudeau #digestion #guthealth #wellness #healthfacts #nutritiontips
